blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — An economist on Wednesday took issue with Senator Alan Peter Cayetano’s proposal asking Filipinos to pay an additional P170,000 each to help settle the national debt. Rosario Guzman, head researcher of the think tank Ibon Foundation, said that Filipinos were already shouldering its cost through taxes and deteriorating public services. Meanwhile, Senator Panfilo “Ping” Lacson took exception to Senator Alan Peter Cayetano’s sweeping characterization of public servants as thieves, saying honest officials should not be lumped together with corrupt ones.
